context: Naoko shares cooking failures with Aoi; honest professional chat.
purpose: Two adult women sharing professional vulnerability.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 蒼ちゃん、今日、失敗してもうたわ。
lines.style: Slow, weighted opening. Kansai lilt, self-deprecating but honest. A beat of actual regret before the warmth settles back in. Not performing—just telling.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Gentle, curious lean forward. Warm but not prying. The tone that says 'I'm here to listen, not judge.' Soft on the question mark.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 塩、間違いで、ようけ入れた。
lines.en: I added way too much salt by accident.
lines.style: Kansai warmth still there but deflated. Self-aware—almost rueful laugh underneath the words. Quick, like she's embarrassed but brave enough to say it plainly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うまくいかない日も、ありますよ。
lines.en: Everyone has days when things don't go right.
lines.style: Steady reassurance, no condescension. Speaking from experience. Warm and matter-of-fact at once, like she's seen this before and knows it passes.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: I've been thinking about it hard ever since.
lines.style: Vulnerable admission. Kansai softness. Not fishing for sympathy but letting the truth out—she's been sitting with this. Slight trailing off, like she's still processing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 次回、工夫で改善できるね。
lines.en: You can adjust for next time.
lines.style: Forward-looking and practical. Light, almost gentle firmness—not dismissing the mistake but reframing it as fixable. A small nod of confidence in her voice.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 一般客にも、お詫び、しっかりしたで。
lines.en: I properly apologized to the customers too.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Kansai directness. A little lift on 'properly'—she did the right thing and knows it. Not bragging, just owning it.
